name: Obadiah
overview: Obadiah is a male prophet identified in Scripture by the unique attribute of being "the prophet" as noted in Obadiah 1:1. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal details. His role as a prophet marks him as a divinely appointed messenger in the biblical narrative.
namesAndTitles: The name Obadiah means "servant [worshiper] of YHWH," reflecting a life devoted to God. This proper name, as given in Obadiah 1:1, emphasizes his relationship to the Lord and his calling to serve Him faithfully.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Obadiah beyond what is listed in his unique attribute as a prophet. There are no additional relational details provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Obadiah's significance lies in his prophetic ministry, serving as a messenger of God's word. His identity as "the prophet" underscores his role in delivering divine revelation. Though specific events or teachings are not detailed here, his presence in the canon confirms his importance in God's redemptive plan.
